name: The Butterfly and the Centipede
source:
You arrive at Mount Vitalis with a worn letter. Biston, the Monarch of Life, offers solace – and a truth that will alter your path.

[From [url=https://inkymoth.itch.io/the-butterfly-and-the-centipede]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你带着一封破旧的信到达维塔利斯山。比斯顿，生命的君主，提供安慰——以及一个将改变你的道路的真理。

[来自[url=https://inkymoth.itch.io/the-butterfly-and-the-centipede]Itch.io[/url]]
